rows.label: tlk43400441_03_msg0001
rows.name: Hello... How are you all doing?

rows.label: tlk43400441_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I've been using Folta to make omusubi
for the children, like Musubi used to
make for me.

rows.label: tlk43400441_03_msg0003
rows.name:
They've been surprisingly popular, and
the kids ask for them every day.

rows.label: tlk43400441_03_msg0004
rows.name:
At this rate, I'll end up just like
Musubi. I'd like to make other dishes
too, though.
